scope: Charting terminals, broker workstations, and adjacent research/social tools ClearPath traders compare against.

metricool.analyticsPath: Analytics → select network (Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, …) → Competitors → Add
metricool.important: Metricool tracks public social profiles, not desktop software installs. For each brand below, add its official Facebook Page, Instagram professional account, and (on paid plans) YouTube channel or X handle — search by exact brand name inside Metricool.
metricool.note: Free Metricool accounts cannot delete competitors once added — pick the five brands you care about most per network before clicking Add.
